data.one_liner: Translate raw file size numbers or strings into human readable strings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple function to convert raw file sizes into human-readable strings with customizable precision. It supports input as either numbers or strings and calculates standard storage units like KB, MB, and TB.
use_when: You need to display file sizes in a human-readable format
You want a lightweight library with no external dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex file system manipulation or path resolution
strengths: Supports both number and string inputs
Allows specifying the number of decimal digits
weaknesses: Very limited scope providing only a single formatting utility
